visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up view of a person's hands holding a stack of three thick, golden-brown waffles overflowing with various fillings. The background is a brightly lit indoor cafe environment. (2) The scene shifts to showing a hand placing two wrapped waffle sandwiches into small woven baskets lined with lace-edged paper. The baskets sit on a light-colored wooden table. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the crispy waffle exteriors and the fresh ingredients inside. (3) Batter is poured from a white ladle onto a hot, circular waffle iron with a grid pattern. The iron is then closed. Moments later, the iron is opened to reveal a perfectly cooked, steam-emitting waffle. The setting is a clean, professional kitchen with stainless steel equipment and staff visible in the background. Subsequently, a piping bag is used to apply rows of fluffy white whipped cream over the chocolate. The waffle is then folded to create a sandwich. (6) A cross-section of a finished waffle sandwich is shown, revealing the generous layers of chocolate and cream inside. The person holding it squeezes it slightly to show the cream's softness. The scene is shot in a brightly lit indoor area with blurred cafe furniture in the distance. (7) A savory waffle is prepared on a wire rack. Pieces of crispy fried chicken are placed on top of fresh green lettuce leaves. A hand then pipes a zigzag pattern of dark, glossy sauce over the chicken. The environment is a professional food preparation area. (8) Another savory waffle is shown being assembled with golden-brown fried mushrooms or nuggets and more lettuce. A white, creamy sauce is drizzled over the ingredients. The camera focuses closely on the textures of the fried items and the freshness of the greens. (9) Two large paper cups with a yellow flower pattern on a white background are shown sitting on a table. The cups are filled with beverages, one appearing to be tea and the other a creamy milk tea. The lighting is natural and bright. (10) A wide shot of the store interior shows two staff members wearing brown polo shirts, caps, and masks. They are working behind a counter filled with waffle irons and baskets of food. The cafe has a modern, clean design with light wood and white walls. (11) A view looking down the seating area of the cafe. A customer is seen from the back, sitting at a wooden table. The space is narrow but well-lit with minimalist pendant lights and framed pictures on the walls, creating a cozy atmosphere. (12) An exterior shot of the shopfront displays a glass door and a wooden sign board above the entrance that reads "小木屋鬆餅" in bold characters. Informational text about the store's address and contact info is overlaid on the bottom of the screen.
